(Part 1)'') is the twenty-third chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the {{pkmn|animated series}} episodes ''[[JN077|Ultra Exciting from the Shocking Start!]]'' and ''[[JN080|Trial on a Golden Scale!]]''. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{Ash}} has a [[World Coronation Series]] {{pkmn|battle|match}} against [[Volkner]]. * [[Goh]] participates in his first [[Project Mew]] [[Field Research|Trial Mission]]. ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Luxray}} * {{p|Galvantula}} * {{p|Roggenrola}} * {{p|Ferrothorn}} * {{p|Larvesta}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * [[Goh]] * [[Chloe]] * [[Professor Cerise]] * [[Volkner]] * [[Nito]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Lucario}} ({{OP|Ash|Lucario}}) * {{p|Cinderace}} ({{OP|Goh|Cinderace}}) * {{p|Inteleon}} ({{OP|Goh|Inteleon}}) * {{p|Grookey}} ({{OP|Goh|Grookey}}) * {{p|Eevee}} ({{OP|Chloe|Eevee}}) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Professor Cerise]]'s; [[Rotom Phone]]; ×2) * {{p|Luxray}} ([[Volkner]]'s) * {{p|Galvantula}} ([[Nito]]'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Drone Rotom]]) * {{p|Roggenrola}} (multiple) * {{p|Ferrothorn}} * {{p|Larvesta}} (×2) ==Differences between the animated series and the manga== * This chapter portrays the events of ''[[JN077|Ultra Exciting from the Shocking Start!]]'' and ''[[JN080|Trial on a Golden Scale!]]'' as happening simultaneously. * As all of its previous appearances were skipped, [[Chloe's Eevee]] debuts here. * {{Ash}} and [[Volkner]]'s {{pkmn|battle}} is now a 2-vs-2. [[Ash's Gengar]] and Volkner's {{p|Rotom}} are omitted. * Goh never catches a {{p|Roggenrola}} or {{p|Ferrothorn}}.
